name: Timers
description: Time logs against tasks: server-enforced start/stop (62 — Timer) over an is_running/duration_seconds pair, at most one running timer per owner. No page object — generated UIs (Scroll) manage time logs from the schema; start/stop/running are server routes (objects/site/timer_actions.py), not a generator page. Ships an attention provider for the `submitted` gate: approval is by design somebody other than the person who logged the hours, which makes it the kind of queue that can only be cleared by a person who has no reason to know it exists. The count carries hours in its detail, because nine entries and sixty-two hours are different amounts of afternoon.
